title: Metabolomics and Human Health Conference
level: Researchers (as stated on the conference page)
about: The 2027 Gordon Research Conference "Metabolomics and Human Health" takes place from 28 February to 5 March 2027 at Renaissance Tuscany Il Ciocco in Lucca (Barga), Italy. Applications are submitted through the conference page on grc.org.
